dedupe_keys.name: a meta analysis of environmental tradeoffs of hydropower dams in the sekong sesan and srepok 3s rivers of the lower mekong basin

description: A Meta-Analysis of Environmental Tradeoffs of Hydropower Dams in the Sekong, Sesan, and Srepok (3S) Rivers of the Lower Mekong Basin is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Null, Sarah (deposited on HydroShare). Planning and constructing hydropower dams have historically taken precedence over analyzing their environmental effects. In Mekong riparian countries, hydropower development provides energy, but also threatens biodiversity, ecosystems, food security, and an unparalleled freshwater fishery. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2020-12-29 and last updated 2022-05-17; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
